entries.0a3517544ed7ce94: This is a single segment, Home Hospice Business. It provides care for terminally ill patients with cancer and intractable diseases, supporting end-of-life care (terminal care), in two forms: provision of hospice housing and provision of home hospice services. Operations are carried out by Family Hospice Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥14,168 million.
entries.125097023a3c8410: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥278 million, down from ¥639 million in the previous year.
entries.1eeb53c3fe4c4883: Its head office is located in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, and it forms a group together with its consolidated subsidiary Family Hospice Co., Ltd. As of December 31, 2025, the number of consolidated employees was 1,108.
entries.34462cc43e9ceb48: 24-hour Regular Patrol and On-Demand Visiting Nursing and Care
entries.41eb654c8d4d0576: Hospice teams organized around nurses and specialist staff such as care workers, rehabilitation therapists and cooks provide care at each facility, and the company has put in place a system that can handle visiting nursing and visiting care 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. It is distinctive in that it has staff holding qualifications as certified nurse specialists, certified nurses and nurses for intractable diseases, enabling it to provide palliative care based on a high level of expertise.
entries.55108a18e31f7a4d: This is a single segment, Home Hospice Business.
entries.661ecd6eef8498da: Rental income and other income related to hospice residences
entries.667de3f513c9856c: Patients with terminal cancer and patients with intractable diseases
entries.6a2eca2203f09e75: The company has a single segment, the Home Hospice Business, and as of December 31, 2025, its consolidated subsidiary Family Hospice Co., Ltd. operates 59 hospice residences with 2,024 rooms, from Hokkaido to Hyogo Prefecture. Its major customers for revenue are the National Health Insurance Federations of Kanagawa, Aichi and Tokyo.
entries.74acaea94df55194: Medical insurance revenue (medical fees and users' co-payments)
entries.76189482c86c097f: With the mission of 'research and dissemination of home hospice care,' and to respond to the growing number of end-of-life cases, it plans to increase facilities through nationwide expansion of hospice residences of around 30 rooms each, and to contribute to regional medical networks through combined services such as nursing small-scale multifunctional in-home care and home visiting nursing. For the fiscal year ending December 2026, it positions the year as a period of adjustment to the medical fee revision, and plans to limit new openings to seven facilities for which lease agreements have already been signed.
entries.7bdbc840a68db4f7: The business description states that the company's features include providing care services through a hospice team centered on nurses; developing home hospice care by combining visiting nursing and visiting care available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, with hospice residences; and having multiple staff holding qualifications such as certified nurse specialists and certified nurses.
entries.826e0c46dbef50e4: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥14,168 million, up 17.0% from the previous year. The company opened 11 new facilities (415 rooms), bringing the number of hospice residences it operates to 59 facilities with 2,024 rooms.
entries.8478b70a97160151: The business description states a list of a total of 59 hospice facilities operated by the company group as of December 31, 2025, and the trend in the number of rooms (2,024 rooms at the end of the fiscal year ended December 2025). The information by major customer states ¥2,741,105 thousand for the National Health Insurance Federation of Kanagawa Prefecture, ¥2,382,277 thousand for the National Health Insurance Federation of Aichi Prefecture and ¥2,175,372 thousand for the National Health Insurance Federation of Tokyo.
entries.917b94471f027e13: Net income attributable to owners of the parent
entries.aca3885081c652fb: The business model involves nurses and other staff stationed 24 hours a day, 365 days a year at hospice residences to provide palliative care, delivering visiting nursing and care services to homes, and earning income from medical and long-term care insurance benefits and residence rent, among other sources.
entries.af9627ed560e1620: A category that provides rental housing (serviced housing for the elderly, residential fee-based nursing homes and nursing-care fee-based nursing homes) limited to residents such as terminal cancer patients and patients with intractable diseases. With visiting nursing and home-help care offices attached or nearby, nurses and others are stationed 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, providing palliative care, daily living support and meal services. At least 9 tenths of sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were obtained from providing this hospice housing. As of December 31, 2025, it operates 59 facilities with 2,024 rooms.
entries.cdc0c39c3d77b5ad: The category is provided with the aim of continuing life at home, where people are used to living, and combines mainly visiting nursing with small-scale multi-function home-based nursing care, home care support offices, home-visit care, day-service care, and 24-hour regular-patrol and on-demand visiting nursing and care, among others.
entries.d7394781bbda4ce6: This segment provides rental housing (serviced housing for the elderly, residential fee-based nursing homes, and fee-based nursing care homes) whose residents are limited to terminal cancer patients, patients with intractable diseases and the like.
entries.d7dbfe840037754e: A company that provides home hospice care (end-of-life care) to terminally ill cancer patients and patients with intractable diseases, combining hospice housing with home-visit nursing and caregiving.
entries.dcbba31683087dea: Targeting patients with terminal cancer and intractable diseases, it provides terminal care responding to 'mitori' (end-of-life care) in two forms: the provision of hospice residences and the provision of home hospice services.
entries.ddddcafa89f32744: The targets of care are patients with terminal cancer and patients with intractable diseases who wish to spend time freely at home or in a residence while relieving pain and suffering.
entries.fafcf9aecbe8c24c: Long-term care insurance revenue (nursing care fees and users' co-payments)
